subject: Shared path update and corrected date
text:
Hi,

You asked for the latest on the shared garden path. The edging along the south strip is done, the sinking gravel has been leveled, and the storage shed now holds the extra stakes without blocking the sidewalk. The drainage grate near the bench was replaced after the first storm test, and the team says the runoff now moves away from the gate instead of pooling beside the mailbox.

I also need to correct one detail about the work session. I had the calendar entry wrong. I believed the volunteer cleanup was scheduled for next Friday, but it is actually next Saturday, from 9 a.m. until noon. If you were planning to bring your rake on Friday, please hold that until the following morning instead. That mistake came from reading the printed schedule and the online reminder as if they matched, and they do not.

There are only two open items left. First, the wooden border near the compost bin needs one more coat of sealant, likely once the weather stays dry for a full day. Second, the small lamp posts have not been installed yet because the delivery was delayed by one day. They should arrive Thursday, and installation can proceed Friday afternoon if the site is cleared.

Please let me know whether you still want to help at the start of the Saturday session. There are tasks for raking, carrying mulch, and checking the path for loose stones. If not, no problem at all. I will just make sure the tools are returned to the shed and locked before the day ends.
